title: Physical-Retina SwiftUI circle-reveal coverage discovery corpus

openedFacts: all 51 canonical frames are identical across cold-forward, warm-reverse, and cold-repeat traversals
the source-PNG comparison is confounded by Color LCD to sRGB canonicalization
same-surface endpoint comparison leaves 44,612 neither-endpoint pixels per traversal
38,441 of those pixels lie within 1.5 physical pixels of the circle edge
the effective physical radius is floor(diameterPixels) / 2
one deterministic 6,171-pixel off-edge region at state 11 requires raw-source separation

capture.device: Apple M1 Max with built-in Liquid Retina XDR display

rawSourceSampling.encoding: versioned little-endian BGRA8 source-provider samples before canonical Color LCD to sRGB conversion
rawSourceSampling.radialBlocks: 64 input-selected 16 by 16 physical-pixel patches centered on equally spaced angles of floor(diameterPixels)/2

postCaptureDiscriminators: analytic gradient versus fine-quad finite-derivative feather
analytic SDF ramp versus exact pixel-area coverage
analytic SDF ramp versus fixed multisample patterns
raw Color LCD source bytes versus canonical sRGB conversion
procedure: Commit and publish this preregistration, capture source, corpus validator, tests, and native runner before opening any black-to-white Apple output.
Build GlassCapture with Apple Command Line Tools only in a clean committed checkout.
Run directly in the active, awake, unlocked, on-console 2x Retina session without GitHub Actions, a debugger, or a Nix-store path in the native build or capture environment.
Capture 65 exact states in all three traversals with the diagnostic black-to-white source pair and retain the frozen raw source-provider sample blocks.
Only after native capture exits, use the repository Nix environment for corpus validation and arithmetic analysis.

claimBoundary.successfulGatePromotes: a complete deterministic physical-Retina discovery corpus for solving the reveal edge and ColorSync split
